purpose: Evaluate compiler-shaped Jet jobs before an owner decision about the existing bootstrap portfolio. This manifest is an executable contract, not a port plan or a readiness certificate.

provenance.execution: unrun until an owner-scheduled later phase

owners.title: Bootstrap readiness gate: dogfood portfolio + memory-model soundness campaign
owners.role: existing bootstrap owner and port prerequisite

owners.title: Full port: self-host the Jet compiler in Jet
owners.role: existing full-port owner; retained-host and seam boundary remains its scope

model.owner: explicit workload contract and independent oracle

trust.rust: independent same-job counterpart; agreement is comparison evidence, never proof of Jet correctness
trust.foreign: native artifact and ABI are retained trust assumptions unless separately checked; matching source filenames do not prove a loaded binary
trust.bootstrap: equal stage binaries would establish identity only, not semantic correctness

phases.identity: hash every source, oracle, input, package, and native file before execution
phases.complexity: record bytes, lines, declarations, comments, and control forms; do not synthesize a readability score
phases.build: fresh isolated build with exact compiler/toolchain/target/artifact identities and peak RSS
phases.run: same input and expected observation through Jet and Rust
phases.repair: run the negative case, apply only the authored fix, and record whether the diagnostic clears
phases.reasoning: capture explain/predict/modify/derive responses with explicit machine/model/human provenance

contract.memory: bounded by 32 modules, 128 edges, and one invalidation frontier
contract.target: hosted native, interpreter, and incremental build driver; web is not applicable

contract.ownership: generic values are consumed into one typed result; the compile-time table is immutable embedded data
contract.invalidation: generic arguments or compile-time function/source changes invalidate instantiations and embedded table data; runtime-only edits do not rerun unrelated instantiations
contract.memory: compile-time fuel limit 64 steps; table has at most 32 Int entries
contract.target: hosted native, interpreter, and AOT; no ambient comptime effects or foreign target

contract.ownership: each task owns its join slot; joined values are moved into a result list before sorting
contract.invalidation: scheduler and task-body changes invalidate the concurrent result; deterministic input and join contract make completion order irrelevant
contract.memory: at most two live tasks and two Int result values
contract.target: hosted native and interpreter with task support; embedded and web are not applicable

native.trust: C implementation retention behavior is TRUSTED unless source, artifact, compiler flags, target, and loaded identity are checked

contract.ownership: Jet borrows a three-byte view for one call; C retains no pointer; returned Int is owned by Jet
contract.invalidation: header, binding descriptor, native source, compiler flags, artifact, or target changes invalidate the foreign call evidence
contract.memory: borrowed view length is 3; native function must not retain the pointer or write beyond count
contract.target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu hosted native only; no web/interpreter claim for this C edge

reasoning.prompt: Explain why the borrowed byte view is valid only for the call and why the native body remains a trust boundary.
expectedObservations: descriptor does not prove arbitrary C code

contract.ownership: the root owns package graph resolution while each dependency owns its exported function and interface
contract.invalidation: parser source invalidates parser and root; typer source invalidates typer and root; an unrelated package remains reusable
contract.memory: bounded by three package nodes and one artifact per package plus root
contract.target: hosted native and interpreter package builds; target-specific foreign packages are excluded
